title: Browse, where a newcomer finds the neighbourhood

criteria.text: Browse is its own surface at `/explore`, own tab; not merged with Home
criteria.note: Nav tab Explore (`BottomNav.tsx`), `/` redirects to `/explore` (`src/app/page.tsx`, Home paused, #138) [V]. Reviewed no: #138 and #308 carry no `Reviewed by:`. Shipped: deploy-health green on 3d7b5974 and 78cdefbd [V]. Smoked: smoke-live opened /explore on 7f38b45b (2026-10-16, 15 passed) [V]. Checked: unmarked `BottomNav.test.tsx`; nothing asserts Home is not merged in (#589).

criteria.text: Pages and posts together, complete, nothing withheld that the reader may see
criteria.note: Not built as written [V]. Since #800 the default view keeps Pages only (`corpus` in `BrowseSurface.tsx`); posts sit behind the Updates filter. Don ruled 2026-10-16 on #796 (comments) to mix everything by default, with a megaphone or page icon on each card; not built, no open PR. The read is capped at `BROWSE_LIMIT = 100` with no paging, Pages and posts sharing the slots, and #815 says 420 posts were live on 2026-10-15, so rows are held back. Issue #828; check in #589.

criteria.text: Signed in, also own announcements and things coming up; signed out, absent
criteria.note: `FollowingRow` plus `HappeningRows` for a member, withheld cards only signed out (`load.ts`, #204, #505) [V]. Since #800 both sit behind the Updates filter, not the default view; Don's 2026-10-16 ruling on #796 puts followed updates in the default mix (#828). Reviewed no: #204 has no `Reviewed by:`, #505 is `review-skipped`. Shipped: deploy-health green on 70190413, 79db7a89, 24891b70. Checked: unmarked `load.test.ts`, `FollowingRow.test.tsx` (#589). Smoked: smoke-live 2026-10-15 (24891b7) and 2026-10-16 (7f38b45) were green and opened /explore signed out and as members; it loads the route, it does not tap [V].

criteria.text: Signed-in half withheld server-side, never rendered and hidden
criteria.note: `followedFeed` runs only when signed in; the SQL predicate on `p_following` withholds; an empty follow set still calls the query; signed out resolves no follow set (`load.ts`) [V]. #800 added no new read. Reviewed no (#204 carries no `Reviewed by:`). Shipped: deploy-health green on 70190413. Checked: unmarked `load.test.ts` ('never asks for it at all', 'still makes the call'), `load-withheld.test.ts`; no standing guard (#589). Smoked: smoke-live 2026-10-15 (24891b7) and 2026-10-16 (7f38b45) were green and opened /explore signed out and as members; it loads the route, it does not tap [V].

criteria.text: Order is locality and recency; never payment, size, follower count or what keeps you scrolling
criteria.note: `browse_feed` orders by recency inside the metro or area; `session-shuffle.ts` shuffles only inside recency bands; the #800 first look picks what is new, reshuffled per visit [V]. Hood, town and adjacency order is F104, not built (#697). No guard scans for payment, size, follower count or engagement columns (#590). Under review (2026-10-12, [for now], Find only): the 'doesn't favour a member because of payment' clause, for paid promotion on Discover. Reviewed no (#161 no line, #558 and #815 `review-skipped`). Shipped: green on 56404a51, f7782d6f, 24891b70, b7766901. Smoked: smoke-live 2026-10-15 (24891b7) and 2026-10-16 (7f38b45) were green and opened /explore signed out and as members; it loads the route, it does not tap [V].

criteria.text: Curated lenses (today, local food, household, art, free, newly opened Pages), each a way to change what is discoverable
criteria.note: Built half [V]: 'What's new since you were here' first look (tonight, this weekend, last-minute openings, Pages new since the last visit, #800 `lead.ts`), the 'What's happening' rows (F091, behind Updates), a tag filter in the sheet. Missing: local food, household and art lenses as shown rows (the 12 interest tags now on unclaimed Pages, #818, are the substrate); the newcomers lens is only a part of the first look and has no thin-row rule; the free lens waits on what makes a thing free (#832, needs-pm). #57 proposes chips, which this criterion rules out. Issue #587.

criteria.text: No exhaustive kind picker; typed search stays a separate job
criteria.note: The kind pills and chips were deleted in #174; `BrowseSurface.tsx` renders no pill or chip row, search is the box [V]. Nothing stops them coming back (guard in #590). Watch: Don's 2026-10-16 ruling on #796 adds a Type filter (Pages or posts, post kind) in the sheet; not built, and it is not recorded in the scenario's Rulings. Reviewed no (#174 has no `Reviewed by:`). Shipped: green on 9dde664f. Smoked: smoke-live 2026-10-15 (24891b7) and 2026-10-16 (7f38b45) were green and opened /explore signed out and as members; it loads the route, it does not tap [V].

criteria.note: As written, not built: #479 (Don's #328) replaced the pill with one expanding control at the bottom right (`ExploreDock.tsx`) that opens to search, filter, metro and List/Map [V]. The scenario's 2026-10-01 ruling says bottom centre; #328's change is newer, but no dated line in the scenario's Rulings records it. Routed to `scope-scenario`; nothing built or filed until it is ruled. The dock is covered by `BrowseSurface.layout.test.tsx` (#328 block, unmarked).

criteria.text: Results scope to the vantage's market (home market by default, a typed place for the session); nobody picks a market, none is picked from IP
criteria.note: Restated 2026-10-11 (F104, F105); this read 'scoped to the active metro'. Not built [V]: scope is still a metro chosen by `?metro=`, the picker, the device cookie or the member's default setting, with `resolveFeedMetro` falling back to Sacramento (`scope.ts`, `feed-metro.ts`); no market or vantage model, no waiting-market absence. Issues #696 (market scoping) and #698 (place control), both `deferred` to the fortnight after beta. #588 (no-metro visitor) is answered by F105 criterion 5 and is stale.

criteria.text: The place control moves a signed-in member's results, not only a signed-out visitor's
criteria.note: Restated 2026-10-11 (F105 place control); this read 'the metro switcher moves a signed-in member's results'. Built half [V]: the metro switcher and a neighbourhood search (#479, #476) move a member's results and save the pick as their default. Missing: the place control that takes any typed town, county or market, as session state only; F105 replaces the saved default. Issue #698.

criteria.note: Since #815 `browse_feed` keeps a dated post until `coalesce(ends_at, starts_at)` passes; an undated post never drops (migration 20261016150052) [V]. Reviewed no (#161 no line, #815 `review-skipped`). Shipped: green on 56404a51 and b7766901. Smoked unknown: the last smoke-live run (2026-10-16 14:57) is before #815's merge (15:19). Checked: unmarked `tests/migrations-browse-feed.test.ts` ('drops a past-dated post on its own', 'keeps a post that has started and not ended') (#589).
